from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A monthly data point extracted from a single report, containing permit and start rates."""
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report containing this data was released (YYYY-MM-DD)")
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data applies to (YYYY-MM)")
    permits_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for total building permits")
    starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for total housing starts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Schema for extracting monthly construction statistics from a single document."""
    monthly_data_points: list[MonthlyDataPoint]
